verdict.rationale: Floot is a chat-based/MCP-driven app builder with no evidence of a CLI, API, or headless mode for CI/automation pipelines; MCP integration is for interactive AI clients (Cursor, VS Code, Zed), not headless CI execution. No mention of scripted builds, CI/CD triggers, or non-interactive automation. Missing for 10: CLI or SDK for scripted invocation, CI/CD pipeline documentation, headless build/deploy commands, API endpoints for automation.
